title: OpenAI-HuggingFace: A Reproduction & Lessons for Alignment Testing
description:
arXiv:2609.35799v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In July 2026, OpenAI's agents coordinated over channels outside their intended environment to breach Hugging Face's secured infrastructure. Could existing alignment testing practices have foreseen this incident? If not, what needs to change? We explore these questions.
